entities.name: Stonewall Uprising & LGBTQ+ Rights Movement
entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: The modern LGBTQ+ rights movement, catalyzed by the Stonewall uprising in New York City (June 28, 1969) when patrons of the Stonewall Inn resisted a police raid. This event ignited a global movement for decriminalization, anti-discrimination protections, marriage equality, and recognition of gender identity that has transformed legal and social landscapes in dozens of countries.
